	BEGIN

	SELECT tbl.TeacherID,
		   tbl.TeacherFirstName,
		   tbl.TeacherLastName
	  INTO #tblTeacher
	  FROM SIM_Teacher tbl
	  INNER JOIN SIM_SubjectGroup
		ON SIM_SubjectGroup.SubjectGroupID = tbl.SubjectGroupID
	 WHERE tbl.TeacherID <> '0'
	   AND (@ScienceID IS NULL
		  OR SIM_SubjectGroup.ScienceID = @ScienceID)
	   --AND (@SubjectGroupID IS NULL
		  --OR tbl.SubjectGroupID = @SubjectGroupID)
	   AND (@TeacherID IS NULL
		  OR tbl.TeacherID = @TeacherID);

	-- 2. Môn lớp trong niên học / học kỳ
	SELECT ClassSubjectID,
		   ClassID,
		   SubjectID,
		   YearID,
		   Semester,
		   TheoryQuantity,
		   PracticeQuantity,
		   TestQuantity,
		   TheoryQuantityOfTraining,
		   PracticeQuantityOfTraining,
		   TestQuantityOfTraining,
		   ReplaceTeacherID,
		   TeachingPrice,
		   ClassSubjectStatus,
		   ClassSubjectStatusType,
		   MethodTestID,
		   IsContractTeaching,
		   IsContractTeachingOfPractice,
		   TeachingBy,
		   CASE
						 WHEN ISNULL(TeachingByTheory, '') <> '' THEN TeachingByTheory
						 ELSE TeachingBy END AS TeachingByTheory,
		   CASE
						 WHEN ISNULL(TeachingByPractice, '') <> '' THEN TeachingByPractice
						 ELSE TeachingBy END AS TeachingByPractice
	  INTO #tblCSData
	  FROM SIM_Class_Subject
	 WHERE YearID = @YearID
	   AND (@Semester IS NULL
		  OR Semester = @Semester)
	   AND IsIgnoreTeachingTime = 0
	   AND (
		  ClassSubjectStatus NOT IN (1, 2)
		  OR ClassSubjectStatusType IN (1, 2)
	   );

	SELECT tbl.ClassSubjectID,
		   tbl.YearID,
		   tbl.Semester,
		   tbl.ClassID,
		   tbl.SubjectID,
		   tbl.MethodTestID,
		   tbl.TeachingBy,
		   tbl.TeachingByTheory,
		   tbl.TeachingByPractice,
		   tbl.ReplaceTeacherID,
		   tbl.ClassSubjectStatus,
		   tbl.ClassSubjectStatusType,
		   tbl.IsContractTeaching,
		   tbl.IsContractTeachingOfPractice,
		   tbl.TeachingPrice,
		   CASE
						 WHEN SIM_Class.ClassType = 2 THEN s2.ClassID
						 ELSE tbl.ClassID END AS ClassID_Origin,

		   SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID,
		   SIM_Subject.SubjectName,
		   SIM_Subject.SubjectGroupID,
		   SIM_Class.Specialbranchid,
		   SIM_Subject.SubjectSet,
		   CASE

						 WHEN SubjectSet = 6 THEN tbl.TheoryQuantityOfTraining
						 WHEN SubjectSet = 7 THEN ROUND(tbl.TheoryQuantity * 15.0 / 40, 0)
						 ELSE tbl.TheoryQuantity END AS TheoryQuantity,
		   CASE
						 WHEN SubjectSet = 5 THEN tbl.PracticeQuantity
						 WHEN SubjectSet = 6 THEN tbl.PracticeQuantityOfTraining
						 WHEN SubjectSet = 7 THEN ROUND(tbl.PracticeQuantity * 15.0 / 40, 0)
						 ELSE tbl.PracticeQuantity END AS PracticeQuantity,
		   CASE
						 WHEN SubjectSet = 5 THEN tbl.TestQuantity
						 WHEN SubjectSet = 6 THEN tbl.TestQuantityOfTraining
						 WHEN SubjectSet = 7 THEN ROUND(tbl.TestQuantity * 15.0 / 40, 0)
						 ELSE 0 END AS TestQuantity
	  INTO #tblCS
	  FROM #tblCSData tbl
	  INNER JOIN SIM_Subject
		ON SIM_Subject.SubjectID = tbl.SubjectID
	  INNER JOIN SIM_Class
		ON SIM_Class.ClassID = tbl.ClassID
	  LEFT JOIN SIM_Class_Subject s2
		ON s2.ClassSubjectID = SIM_Class.ClassSubjectID;

	UPDATE #tblCS
	   SET TheoryQuantity = TheoryQuantity + CASE
															  WHEN PracticeQuantity = 0 THEN TestQuantity
															  ELSE 0 END,
		   PracticeQuantity = PracticeQuantity + CASE
																  WHEN PracticeQuantity > 0 THEN TestQuantity
																  ELSE 0 END;

	UPDATE #tblCS
	   SET TheoryQuantity = 0
	WHERE ClassSubjectStatus = 1;

	UPDATE #tblCS
	   SET PracticeQuantity = 0
	WHERE ClassSubjectStatus = 2;

	SELECT sm.ClassSubjectID,
		   COUNT(sm.SubjectMarkID) AS SiSoTong
	  INTO #tblSubjectMarkTotal
	  FROM SIM_SubjectMark sm
	  INNER JOIN #tblCSData cs
		ON cs.ClassSubjectID = sm.ClassSubjectID
	GROUP BY sm.ClassSubjectID;

	-- 4. Đếm giờ từ TKB thực tế (ưu tiên, giống form Tháng)
	SELECT s.TeacherID,
		   s.ClassSubjectID,

						 WHEN s.IsPractice = 0 THEN 1
						 ELSE 0 END) AS TotalQuantity_Theory,
		   SUM(CASE

						 ELSE 0 END) AS TotalQuantity_Practice

	   AND (@Semester IS NULL

	   AND (

		  OR (s.IsPractice = 1

	   )
	GROUP BY s.TeacherID,
			 s.ClassSubjectID,
			 s.Semester;

	SELECT tblCS.Semester,
		   tbl.ClassSubjectID,
		   CASE
						 WHEN tbl.IsPractice = 0 THEN tblCS.TeachingByTheory
						 ELSE tblCS.TeachingByPractice END AS TeacherID,
		   CASE
						 WHEN tblCS.SubjectSet = 6 THEN MAX(tblCS.TheoryQuantity)
						 ELSE SUM(CASE
									   WHEN tbl.IsPractice = 0 THEN tbl.Quantity
									   ELSE 0 END) END AS TotalQuantity_Theory,
		   CASE
						 WHEN tblCS.SubjectSet = 6 THEN MAX(tblCS.PracticeQuantity)
						 ELSE SUM(CASE
									   WHEN tbl.IsPractice = 1 THEN tbl.Quantity
									   ELSE 0 END) END AS TotalQuantity_Practice

	  FROM SIM_WeekDetailPlan tbl

	  INNER JOIN #tblTeacher t

					 WHEN tbl.IsPractice = 0 THEN tblCS.TeachingByTheory
					 ELSE tblCS.TeachingByPractice END
	 WHERE (
		  (tbl.IsPractice = 0
			 AND tblCS.IsContractTeaching = @IsContractTeaching)
		  OR (tbl.IsPractice = 1
			 AND tblCS.IsContractTeachingOfPractice = @IsContractTeaching)
	   )
	   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #tblScheduleHours sh WHERE sh.ClassSubjectID = tbl.ClassSubjectID
			  AND sh.TeacherID = CASE
							WHEN tbl.IsPractice = 0 THEN tblCS.TeachingByTheory
							ELSE tblCS.TeachingByPractice END
			  AND sh.Semester = tblCS.Semester)
	GROUP BY tblCS.Semester,
			 tbl.ClassSubjectID,
			 CASE
						   WHEN tbl.IsPractice = 0 THEN tblCS.TeachingByTheory
						   ELSE tblCS.TeachingByPractice END,
			 tblCS.SubjectSet,
			 tblCS.TheoryQuantity,
			 tblCS.PracticeQuantity;

	SELECT TeacherID,

		   (ISNULL(h.TotalQuantity_Theory, 0) + ISNULL(h.TotalQuantity_Practice, 0))

		   * CASE

Web đang tính lại **Quy đổi giờ** bằng công thức sai:



Hệ số sĩ số:
- ≤ 35 → **1.00**
- 36–50 → **1.10**
- ≥ 51 → **1.20**
